test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: How many Fundamental Duties were added in the Constitution of India by the 42nd Amendment?
solution:
The correct answer is __**10.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fundamental duties were added to the Constitution of India through the 42nd Amendment in 1976.**
 
• The amendment added a total of **10 Fundamental Duties** under** Article 51A **of the Constitution.
 
• These duties are **non-justiciable,** which means that they cannot be enforced by law.
 
• The aim of adding Fundamental Duties was to promote a sense of **responsibility and patriotism** among citizens towards the nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Russian Constitution** served as the model for the concept of Fundamental Duties.
 
• **In addition to the original 10 duties, one more was added by the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act of 2002.**
 
• According to the **Ranganath Mishra** ruling from the Supreme Court in** 2003,** social sanctions** **should also be used to enforce fundamental duties.
 
• **The Supreme Court ruled in AIIMS Students Union v. AIIMS 2001 that fundamental duties are just as significant as fundamental rights.​**
